MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable 2TB drive felt like a useful next step because I could consolidate files from my several memory cards in one portable place.",
    "Storage was a reasonable connection to my history of memory cards and a card reader, although only the portable drive matched a need I could identify now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 16TB drive and 24-port switch offered capacity far beyond any need reflected in my purchases; being useful electronics did not give me a reason to choose them.",
    "The audio cables looked similar to accessories I buy, but my cables solve specific connection needs, and I have no identified use for these connectors.",
    "The streaming devices, Alexa devices, and monitoring camera introduced uses I am not currently pursuing. My photography accessories do not imply a need for home monitoring, and owning a TV or tablet does not mean I want more viewing devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of a Fire tablet and a TV seemed to be treated as continuing interest in streaming and Alexa devices.",
    "My interest in memory cards, cables, and camera equipment seemed to be stretched into interest in almost any storage device, connector, or camera."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Many of my purchases support equipment I already own, such as a tablet case, memory-card reader, GPS mount, and lens cap; the particular device and task matter to me.",
    "Repeated memory-card purchases make file storage plausible, but they do not establish a need for 16TB. A portable drive has a clearer purpose for me.",
    "I interact frequently, but each accessory still needs a concrete use; frequent activity does not mean I currently want to add streaming, voice control, or home monitoring."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical electronics but often missed the specific equipment, connection needs, and scale that make an accessory useful to me."
}
